text:
maya: Heads-up: I'm seeing a quality regression on mistral-7b after the recent kernel selector tweak. Long-context QA suite drops ~6% exact match when ropescale=0.5. Repro attached below.

tim: Can you paste the repro + config? Which selector change landed?

maya: repro (short):
```bash
curl -sX POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -d '{"model":"mistral-7b-compact","prompt":"<long-document>...","max_tokens":256,"rope_scale":0.5,"batching":{"min_batch_size":4,"max_latency_ms":50}}'
```
The change was runtime: kernel-selector prefers tiled-attn for effective_seq>1024. We hit that path because kv_cache + prefix makes effective seq ~1200 for many eval cases.

ellie: Profiling snippet from a failing run (canary):
```
PROFILE SUMMARY (canary)
- total_tokens: 124k
- tiled_attn_kernel: 42.8% time (selected for layer 7-12)
- fused_flash_kernel: 32.1%
- fallback_slow_path: 12.7% (roperesize adjustments)
- kv_lookup_time: +18% vs baseline
```
We also see higher FP32 reductions in some heads after tiled path.

perf-bot: [alert] eval/qa-long-context: baseline -> canary regression. precision -6.2%, recall -4.9%. Threshold exceeded. CI: link_to_run/5743

raj: I briefly toggled the quantization compatibility flag last week (PR #4898) but that was gated to dedicated only. Not sure it's related.

maya: I did a quick diff: when tiled_attn runs with ropescale=0.5 we get slightly different rotary angle interpolation compared to fused_flash. The numeric drift accumulates for long contexts -> answer drift. Small but enough to change top answer.

tim: Possible mitigations: 1) force old kernel for mistral-7b on canary and re-run eval; 2) change kernel selector threshold (seq cutoff) up; 3) add numeric-alignment shim in tiled kernel to match fused interface. Which is fastest?

ellie: Fastest is (1) or (2). (3) is higher-effort and needs kernel-level changes + perf rerun. Also check KV cache head dim mapping — I noticed an edge case where effective_head_dim for mixtral -> mistral porting led to 68 vs 64 mismatch in a transient path, which can amplify drift.

maya: I'm going to open a rollback flag for the selector and run canary tests. Command to reproduce targeted eval locally:
```bash
./tools/eval/run_eval --suite qa-long-context --model mistral-7b-compact --rope-scale 0.5 --kernel-selector=v0
```
where v0 is the previous selector.

raj: On it. Opening PR to gate the new selector behind a runtime flag: PR #4921. Patch: runtime.flags.attn_selector_new=false by default. Will roll to canary in ~15m.

perf-bot: Deployed runtime.flags.attn_selector_new=false to canary pool (canary-3). Linked run: link_to_canary/22

tim: Once canary finishes, please post eval diffs. If rollback fixes it we ship rollback and schedule a bisect of the kernel change.

maya: After gating to old selector, quick canary run shows regression vanished (precision delta +0.1%). Looks like selector switch is the proximate cause.

ellie: Agree we should bisect kernel selector commit range and also run a numeric fidelity test harness (rotary angle diffs + head-wise KL) across the two kernels for seq lengths 512..4096. I'll start that.

maya: Notes for the postmortem: - root cause: selector favored tiled-attn for effective seq > 1024 which interacts with rope scaling implementation differences -> numeric drift on long contexts. - short-term: gate selector behind flag (done). - next: bisect + shim or adjust selector heuristic and add unit tests for numeric alignment.

tim: assigning owners: ellie for bisect & numeric harness, maya for eval re-runs and rollouts, raj for PR/ops. I'll create a short postmortem doc and link here. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026 and attached CI logs.

maya: thanks — will follow up with repro links and raw traces.
